english.note: Use 棟篤笑 for stand-up comedy, rather than comedy in general.

examples.english: They did stand-up comedy at the Cultural Centre last night and had us laughing nonstop.
examples.traditional: 佢噚晚喺文化中心做棟篤笑，講到我哋笑到停唔到。
